entries.line: - **When to leave:** You want a hosted identity product (Auth0-as-app) or a framework that hides all auth code from the repo entirely — different tradeoffs.

- **[Sigra alternatives comparison](docs/launch/v1.0/alternatives.md)** — boundary-first comparison against `phx.gen.auth`, Pow/Guardian/Ueberauth-style composition, hosted auth, and Sigra's hybrid model.
- A hosted control plane or managed identity service.
- `priv/repo/migrations/*_create_sigra_brand_profiles.exs` — optional global auth/email brand tokens managed from the generated admin UI.
| Pow | Plug/Phoenix session and host-managed auth flow ownership | Sigra keeps core auth in library + generated-host integration responsibilities |
